body.statement: For each selected dual-tight row \(z\), repaired row \(z'\), and displacements \(\delta_a=z'_a-z_a\), the dual slack equals \((\sum_a\delta_a)^2-\sum_a\delta_a^2+\sum_a[\phi_a(z'_a)-\phi_a(z_a)-g_a\delta_a]\), where \(g_a=-2\sum_{b\ne a}z_b\).  Summed over all rows produced by \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{round}}\), this identity and the hierarchical movement bounds give \(N[C_{\mathrm{alg}}(F)-V_{\mathrm{rel}}(F)]\le3\sum_{\ell\ge0}\sum_a h_{a,\ell}^2R_{\ell+1}<402\).
body.justification: The exact slack identity removes the logarithm that a generic bounded-cost or Lipschitz repair argument would accumulate across scales.
body.gap: No cited Monge, mixability, or multi-marginal transport rounding result charges same-marginal integer repair by a dual Bregman remainder for this signed rank-one quadratic cost.
body.consumer: The exact identity and arm-specific summation deliver the universal total-slack constant \(402\).
